name: otrelink
description: Otrelink — a modular, self-hosted Linktree alternative
author: Heberto Urribarri

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,page -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @otrelink/web" "npm run dev -w @otrelink/page"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @otrelink/web && npm run build -w @otrelink/page
